correctness.rationale: Geodesic triple criterion shows a face is wholly in one part or selects at most one vertex from each part, hence join B=D1*...*Dr with separate filled part simplices attached along their discrete vertices. Cofibration homotopy pushouts append a_i−1 one-cells per part, and join of discrete spaces produces Π(a_i−1) spheres S^(r−1). Relative chain LES for (GP,B) identifies H1 as ⊕I_i for r>=3 while join orientation swaps two reduced degree-zero factors by −1, giving the full part-permutation twist. r=2 requires separate pair with the two disjoint shore simplices, giving augmentation kernel on cross edges and sign on shore exchanges. Independently enumerated all faces for size profiles (2,2,2), (1,3,2), (2,3), obtaining 30,29,17 faces including empty. Finite checks do not prove integral or all-rank cases.
